extracted.name: Easy Coleslaw Dressing
extracted.description: For a coleslaw recipe that's creamy and delicious, toss this easy-to-make, 5-minute homemade dressing with a bag of store-bought coleslaw mix.
instruction_lines: Whisk mayonnaise, sugar, lemon juice, vinegar, pepper, and salt together in a bowl until smooth and creamy.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week. Stir before using.
